findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U1
findings.description: U1 (BQ24074RGTR) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U1 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U1 with short, wide traces to vias.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (JST-PH LiPo) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J2

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J1
findings.description: J1 (TYPE-C-31-M-12) has 0 ground pin(s) for 15 signal pins. Recommended: at least 4 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J1

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers F.Cu and In1.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In1.Cu, In2.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In1.Cu and In2.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In1.Cu, In2.Cu

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In2.Cu and B.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (40×50mm, εr=4.5) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 1413 MHz; (1,0) at 1767 MHz; (1,1) at 2262 MHz; (0,2) at 2827 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies
